comments.author: @YosofiHamed
comments.text: Many people think of Iran when they hear about Iranian history, culture, or language, but this is not true. Afghanistan, Iran, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, and several other countries are heirs to a culture and history, each of which shaped this history and culture and has an undeniable contribution. So remember that whenever you hear about Iranian culture, history, or language, it includes all of those countries, not just the country known today as Iran.
